title: Principles Of Epidemiology

Prevention, Treatment And Control Of Hiv/Aids……. 64
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means „Human Immuno-deficiency Virus‟ and AIDS means „Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome‟."
HIV means „Human Immuno-deficiency Virus‟ and AIDS means „Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome‟.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a rate expressed in terms of the total population."
Crude rate - is a rate expressed in terms of the total population.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a combination of vital statistics and other data pertinent to health."
Health statistics are a combination of vital statistics and other data pertinent to health.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an illness that occurs due to a specific causative agent or its toxic products which arises through transmission of that agent or its products from a reservoir to a susceptible host."

A communicable disease is an illness that occurs due to a specific causative agent or its toxic products which arises through transmission of that agent or its products from a reservoir to a susceptible host.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with studying disease occurrence in people and the numerous factors which people are often exposed to that play a significant role in disease occurrence."
The epidemiologist is concerned with studying disease occurrence in people and the numerous factors which people are often exposed to that play a significant role in disease occurrence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very crucial and integral part of HIV/AIDS control and in line with the National Drug Policy launched in 1990."
Treatment with drugs is a very crucial and integral part of HIV/AIDS control and in line with the National Drug Policy launched in 1990.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in Sickle Cell Disease SCD to reduce genetic core."
Counseling is used in Sickle Cell Disease SCD to reduce genetic core.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any human being/animal/anthropod/plants/soil or inanimate matter in which an infectious agent normally lives and multiply and on which it depends primarily for survival."
A reservoir is any human being/animal/anthropod/plants/soil or inanimate matter in which an infectious agent normally lives and multiply and on which it depends primarily for survival.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a test that tells if a person is HIV positive or negative by using a simple blood test or at times making use of saliva or urine."
The HIV test is a test that tells if a person is HIV positive or negative by using a simple blood test or at times making use of saliva or urine.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the successful invasion of the body by micro organisms."
Infection is the successful invasion of the body by micro organisms.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the elongated inner mass of the virus which contains two identical single strands of viral RNA, structural protein, the enzyme reverse transcriptase and other enzymes."
The viral core is the elongated inner mass of the virus which contains two identical single strands of viral RNA, structural protein, the enzyme reverse transcriptase and other enzymes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a retro virus so called because this single stranded RNA (ssRNA) virus contains a pol gene that codes for a reverse transcriptase."
The Human Immuno-Deficiency Virus (HIV) is a retro virus so called because this single stranded RNA (ssRNA) virus contains a pol gene that codes for a reverse transcriptase.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is any organism or agent that is capable of producing infection or infectious diseases."
An infectious agent is any organism or agent that is capable of producing infection or infectious diseases.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the membrane that surrounds the virus."
The envelope is the membrane that surrounds the virus.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the occurrence in a community or region or a member of a defined population or a group having illness of a similar nature in excess of a normal expectancy in that population."

Epidemics can be defined as the occurrence in a community or region or a member of a defined population or a group having illness of a similar nature in excess of a normal expectancy in that population.
fib: ______ are used to generate information for whole groups or entire population.
data
The data are used to generate information for whole groups or entire population.
______ is a periodic count or enumeration of a population.
Census
Census is a periodic count or enumeration of a population.
______ is a two- credit unit course for those offering the Bachelor of Science in Community Health programme.
PRINCIPLES OF EPIDEMIOLOGY
PRINCIPLES OF EPIDEMIOLOGY is a two- credit unit course for those offering the Bachelor of Science in Community Health programme.
______ is an illness that occurs due to a specific causative agent or its toxic products but not transferable from persons to persons.
Non-communicable disease
Non-communicable disease is an illness that occurs due to a specific causative agent or its toxic products but not transferable from persons to persons.
______ is the study of relationship of organisms including humans to each other as well as other aspects of the environment.
Ecology
Ecology is the study of relationship of organisms including humans to each other as well as other aspects of the environment.
______ is an important stage for the development of new drugs.
Intergase
Intergase is an important stage for the development of new drugs.
______ is an unusual occurrence in a community.
epidemic
An epidemic is an unusual occurrence in a community.
______ is a severe, life threatening syndrome which represents the late clinical state of infection with HIV.
AIDS
AIDS is a severe, life threatening syndrome which represents the late clinical state of infection with HIV.
______ is the study of the distribution and determinants of diseases and injuries in human population.
Epidemiology
Epidemiology is the study of the distribution and determinants of diseases and injuries in human population.
______ is the protein coat that surrounds the core (viral genome) of the virus.
capsid
The capsid is the protein coat that surrounds the core (viral genome) of the virus.
______ is the viral encoded glycoprotein (gp), gp41.
Embedded in the envelope
Embedded in the envelope is the viral encoded glycoprotein (gp), gp41.
______ is the age and sex structure of the population displayed in the form of histogram showing the percentage distribution of each sex at 5 yearly intervals.
population pyramid
A population pyramid is the age and sex structure of the population displayed in the form of histogram showing the percentage distribution of each sex at 5 yearly intervals.
______ is considered immune when he possesses specific protective antibodies or cellular immunity as a result of previous infection or immunisation or by previous experience.
individual
An individual is considered immune when he possesses specific protective antibodies or cellular immunity as a result of previous infection or immunisation or by previous experience.
______ are known as CD4 positive cells.
Cells carrying this molecule
Cells carrying this molecule are known as CD4 positive cells.
______ is defined as the proportion of the population affected by a disease at a particular time.
Prevalence rate
Prevalence rate is defined as the proportion of the population affected by a disease at a particular time.
